description_md:
## What You Get

- 
Level-1 Workflow JSON (Workflow 1 of 2): Import-ready n8n file that runs on a schedule for hands-free model tests—its matching Judge workflow lives exclusively inside my paid community.

- 
Auto Model Discovery: Uses OpenRouter to pull every new Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI model in real time and surfaces only the heavy hitters you care about.

- 
Smart Deduplication Logic: Detects models you’ve already benchmarked so you never waste tokens twice.

If you want the companion 'Judge' workflow (Workflow 2 of 2) plus automated scoring dashboards, join the Early AI-dopters Community -- you won’t regret it 😉
